```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)

site_timezone <- "Europe/Zurich"

flags <- tribble(
  ~team, ~flag,
  "DE",  "🇩🇪",
  "GER", "🇩🇪",
  "FIN", "🇫🇮",
  "SUI", "🇨🇭",
  "CH",  "🇨🇭",
  "USA", "🇺🇸",
  "AUT", "🇦🇹",
  "LAT", "🇱🇻",
  "GB",  "🇬🇧",
  "HUN", "🇭🇺",
  "CAN", "🇨🇦",
  "SWE", "🇸🇪",
  "CZE", "🇨🇿",
  "SVK", "🇸🇰",
  "DEN", "🇩🇰",
  "NOR", "🇳🇴",
  "KAZ", "🇰🇿",
  "FRA", "🇫🇷",
  "SLO", "🇸🇮",
  "ITA", "🇮🇹",
  "POL", "🇵🇱"
)

team_label <- function(team_code) {
  flag <- flags$flag[match(team_code, flags$team)]
  ifelse(is.na(flag), team_code, paste(flag, team_code))
}

guesses <- read_csv("data/guesses.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    Date = dmy(Date),
    Time = format(strptime(Time, format = "%H:%M"), "%H:%M"),
    match_start = ymd_hm(
      paste(Date, Time),
      tz = site_timezone
    ),
    match_date = as_date(match_start, tz = site_timezone),
    pred_goal_1 = as.integer(pred_goal_1),
    pred_goal_2 = as.integer(pred_goal_2)
  )

results <- read_csv("data/results.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(
    actual_goal_1 = as.integer(actual_goal_1),
    actual_goal_2 = as.integer(actual_goal_2)
  )

scored <- guesses |>
  left_join(
    results |>
      select(group, match_id, actual_goal_1, actual_goal_2),
    by = c("group", "match_id")
  ) |>
  mutate(
    match_finished = !is.na(actual_goal_1) & !is.na(actual_goal_2),

    pred_outcome = case_when(
      pred_goal_1 > pred_goal_2 ~ "team_1",
      pred_goal_1 < pred_goal_2 ~ "team_2",
      TRUE ~ "draw"
    ),

    actual_outcome = case_when(
      actual_goal_1 > actual_goal_2 ~ "team_1",
      actual_goal_1 < actual_goal_2 ~ "team_2",
      TRUE ~ "draw"
    ),

    pred_diff = pred_goal_1 - pred_goal_2,
    actual_diff = actual_goal_1 - actual_goal_2,

    points = case_when(
  !match_finished ~ NA_integer_,
  pred_goal_1 == actual_goal_1 & pred_goal_2 == actual_goal_2 ~ 3L,
  pred_diff == actual_diff ~ 2L,
  pred_outcome == actual_outcome ~ 1L,
  TRUE ~ 0L
)
  )
```

# Today's revealed guesses

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

now_time <- now(tzone = site_timezone)
today_date <- today(tzone = site_timezone)

todays_games <- guesses |>
  mutate(
    match_date = as_date(match_start, tz = site_timezone)
  ) |>
  filter(
    match_date == today_date
  ) |>
  arrange(match_start, group, match_id, player_name)

if (nrow(todays_games) == 0) {
  cat("No games scheduled for today.")
} else {
  
  match_list <- todays_games |>
    distinct(match_id, group, team_1, team_2, Time, match_start) |>
    arrange(match_start)
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(match_list))) {
    
    this_match <- match_list[i, ]
    
    match_guesses <- todays_games |>
      filter(
        match_id == this_match$match_id,
        group == this_match$group
      ) |>
      mutate(
        Guess = paste0(pred_goal_1, "–", pred_goal_2)
      ) |>
      select(
        Player = player_name,
        Guess
      )
    
    cat('<div class="match-card">\n')
    
    cat(
      '<div class="match-title">',
      team_label(this_match$team_1),
      ' – ',
      team_label(this_match$team_2),
      '</div>\n',
      sep = ""
    )
    
    cat(
      '<div class="match-time">Puck drop: ',
      this_match$Time,
      '</div>\n',
      sep = ""
    )
    
    print(
      knitr::kable(
        match_guesses,
        format = "html",
        align = c("l", "c")
      )
    )
    
    cat('</div>\n\n')
  }
}
```

# Leaderboard

```{r}
#| echo: false

today_date <- today(tzone = site_timezone)

leaderboard <- scored |>
  filter(match_finished) |>
  mutate(
    match_date = as_date(match_start, tz = site_timezone)
  ) |>
  group_by(player_name) |>
  summarise(
    total_points = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE),
    points_today = sum(if_else(match_date == today_date, points, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    exact_scores = sum(points == 3, na.rm = TRUE),
    correct_goal_diff = sum(points == 2, na.rm = TRUE),
    correct_winner = sum(points == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    matches_scored = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(
    desc(total_points),
    desc(points_today),
    desc(exact_scores),
    desc(correct_goal_diff),
    desc(correct_winner),
    player_name
  ) |>
  mutate(
    rank = row_number(),
    rank_display = case_when(
      rank == 1 ~ "🥇 1",
      rank == 2 ~ "🥈 2",
      rank == 3 ~ "🥉 3",
      TRUE ~ as.character(rank)
    ),
    points_today_display = if_else(
      points_today > 0,
      paste0("+", points_today),
      "0"
    )
  ) |>
  select(
    rank_display,
    player_name,
    total_points,
    points_today_display,
    exact_scores,
    correct_goal_diff,
    correct_winner,
    matches_scored
  )
```

```{r}
#| echo: false

knitr::kable(
```

# Points plot

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 5

points_over_time <- scored |>
  filter(match_finished) |>
  mutate(
    match_date = as_date(match_start, tz = site_timezone)
  ) |>
  arrange(match_start, match_id) |>
  group_by(player_name, match_start, match_date, match_id) |>
  summarise(
    points_this_match = sum(points, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(player_name) |>
  arrange(match_start, .by_group = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    total_points = cumsum(points_this_match)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

line_labels <- points_over_time |>
  group_by(player_name) |>
  slice_max(match_date, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup()

if (nrow(points_over_time) > 0) {
  ggplot(
    points_over_time,
    aes(
      x = match_date,
      y = total_points,
      color = player_name,
      group = player_name
    )
  ) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.3) +
    geom_point(size = 2.8) +
    geom_text(
      data = line_labels,
      aes(label = player_name),
      hjust = -0.1,
      size = 4.5,
      show.legend = FALSE
    ) +
    labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Total points",
      title = "Points race over time"
    ) +
    scale_x_date(date_labels = "%d %b") +
    scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.18))) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.margin = margin(10, 90, 10, 10)
    )
}
```

# Match-by-match points
# Match-by-match points

```{r}
#| echo: false

scored |>
  filter(match_finished) |>
  mutate(
    Match = paste0(team_label(team_1), " ", actual_goal_1, "–", actual_goal_2, " ", team_label(team_2)),
    Prediction = paste0(pred_goal_1, "–", pred_goal_2)
  ) |>
  select(
    Player = player_name,
    Match,
    Prediction,
    Points = points
  ) |>
  arrange(Match, desc(Points), Player) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
